gloss: to push down; to knock down; to shove over

definitions.gloss: to push down; to knock down; to shove over
definitions.explanation: To shove or thrust at a person so hard that they fall to the ground. Compound of {突|つ}く (to thrust) + {倒|たお}す (to knock down). The person pushed is marked with を.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}き{倒|たお}す。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ぶつかって→ぶつかる：02412_butsukaru⟧きた⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}き{倒|たお}した。
examples.english: He shoved down the man who bumped into him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{混雑|こんざつ}→混雑：02809_konzatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}き{倒|たお}されそうになった。
examples.english: In the crowd at the station, I was nearly shoved over from behind.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). The person pushed is marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧. Compound of ⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ (to thrust) + ⟦{倒|たお}す→倒す：01954_taosu⟧ (to knock down).

USAGE:
Emphasizes a violent, forceful push that knocks someone off their feet, stronger than plain ⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ (to push).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧いっぱい{突|つ}き{倒|たお}す: to shove down with all one's force
- ⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}き{倒|たお}す: to knock down to the ground
